title: Effect of a selected-tape action
statement: Let a three-work-tape Turing-machine configuration have input head position $p$, work tapes $T_0,T_1,T_2$, work-head positions $h_0,h_1,h_2$, and output string $O$. For a selected tape $t\in\{0,1,2\}$, an action that moves the input head by $im$, prescribes optional write $wr$ and head movement $m$ on tape $t$, emits the optional bit $o$, and sets the state to $q$ produces the configuration with state $q$, input head at the clamped position obtained by moving $p$ by $im$, tape $t$ updated by applying $wr$ at $h_t$, head $t$ moved to $h_t+m$, all other work tapes and heads unchanged, and output $O$ followed by $o$ if present.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean input word w and its input-head position p
Three Boolean work tapes tp and their head positions hd
Input-head movement im and work-head movement m
Optional write wr of an optional Boolean symbol
Initial state q′ and successor state q
